description: This file defines the SBC audio codec class, including configuration, format, and encoding/decoding functionalities for Bluetooth A2DP streaming.

classes.name: SBC
classes.description: Represents the SBC Bluetooth audio codec with configuration, serialization, and encoding/decoding capabilities.

classes.name: SBC::Format
classes.description: Encapsulates the SBC codec format parameters such as sampling frequency, channel mode, block length, subbands, and bitpool range.

classes.name: SBC::Config
classes.description: Configuration class for SBC codec, including preset, channel mode, and bitpool settings.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the SBC codec with provided stream data or format settings.

methods.name: Configuration
methods.description: Outputs the current format and settings of the SBC codec.

methods.name: QOS
methods.description: Sets the Quality of Service policy for the codec.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes raw audio data into SBC frames.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes SBC frames into raw audio data.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the codec capabilities or configuration into a stream.

methods.name: Bitpool
methods.description: Sets the bitpool value for encoding.
